# Linear search

Finds the first position of an element in a list. The specification has two halves: a returned
index holds the target and nothing before it does, and `none` means the target is absent.

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch
declarations.type: {α : Type u} → [BEq α] → α → List α → Option Nat
declarations.doc: The index of the first element equal to `x`, if there is one.
declarations.source:
/-- The index of the first element equal to `x`, if there is one. -/
def linearSearch (x : α) : List α → Option Nat
  | [] => none
  | y :: ys => if y == x then some 0 else (linearSearch x ys).map (· + 1)
declarations.proof:
| [] => none
  | y :: ys => if y == x then some 0 else (linearSearch x ys).map (· + 1)

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch_some
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} {i : Nat},
  Maithic.Algo.linearSearch x l = some i → l[i]? = some x
declarations.doc: A returned index is in bounds and holds the target.
declarations.source:
/-- A returned index is in bounds and holds the target. -/
theorem linearSearch_some [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} {i : Nat}
    (h : linearSearch x l = some i) : l[i]? = some x := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp [linearSearch] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hyx
      have hi : i = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      subst hi
      simpa using hyx
    · cases hrec : linearSearch x ys with
      | none => simp [hrec] at h
      | some j =>
        have hi : i = j + 1 := by simpa [hrec] using h.symm
        subst hi
        simpa using ih hrec
declarations.proof:
by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp [linearSearch] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hyx
      have hi : i = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      subst hi
      simpa using hyx
    · cases hrec : linearSearch x ys with
      | none => simp [hrec] at h
      | some j =>
        have hi : i = j + 1 := by simpa [hrec] using h.symm
        subst hi
        simpa using ih hrec

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch_first
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} {i j : Nat},
  Maithic.Algo.linearSearch x l = some i → j < i → l[j]? ≠ some x
declarations.doc: No element before a returned index equals the target.
declarations.source:
/-- No element before a returned index equals the target. -/
theorem linearSearch_first [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} {i j : Nat}
    (h : linearSearch x l = some i) (hj : j < i) : l[j]? ≠ some x := by
  induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil => simp [linearSearch] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · have hi : i = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      omega
    · rename_i hyx
      cases hrec : linearSearch x ys with
      | none => simp [hrec] at h
      | some k =>
        have hi : i = k + 1 := by simpa [hrec] using h.symm
        subst hi
        cases j with
        | zero => simpa using hyx
        | succ j' => simpa using ih hrec (by omega)
declarations.proof:
by
  induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil => simp [linearSearch] at h
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · have hi : i = 0 := by simpa using h.symm
      omega
    · rename_i hyx
      cases hrec : linearSearch x ys with
      | none => simp [hrec] at h
      | some k =>
        have hi : i = k + 1 := by simpa [hrec] using h.symm
        subst hi
        cases j with
        | zero => simpa using hyx
        | succ j' => simpa using ih hrec (by omega)

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch_none
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.linearSearch x l = none → ¬x ∈ l
declarations.doc: `none` means the target does not occur.
declarations.source:
/-- `none` means the target does not occur. -/
theorem linearSearch_none [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α}
    (h : linearSearch x l = none) : x ∉ l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · simp at h
    · rename_i hyx
      have hrec : linearSearch x ys = none := by simpa using h
      intro hmem
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with rfl | hmem
      · simp at hyx
      · exact ih hrec hmem
declarations.proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons y ys ih =>
    simp only [linearSearch] at h
    split at h
    · simp at h
    · rename_i hyx
      have hrec : linearSearch x ys = none := by simpa using h
      intro hmem
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hmem with rfl | hmem
      · simp at hyx
      · exact ih hrec hmem

declarations.name: Maithic.Algo.linearSearch_isSome_iff
declarations.type:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α},
  (Maithic.Algo.linearSearch x l).isSome = true ↔ x ∈ l
declarations.doc: The search succeeds exactly when the target occurs.
declarations.source:
/-- The search succeeds exactly when the target occurs. -/
theorem linearSearch_isSome_iff [LawfulBEq α] {x : α} {l : List α} :
    (linearSearch x l).isSome ↔ x ∈ l := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hs : linearSearch x l with
    | none => simp [hs] at h
    | some i => exact List.mem_of_getElem? (linearSearch_some hs)
  · intro hmem
    cases hs : linearSearch x l with
    | none => exact absurd hmem (linearSearch_none hs)
    | some i => rfl
declarations.proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hs : linearSearch x l with
    | none => simp [hs] at h
    | some i => exact List.mem_of_getElem? (linearSearch_some hs)
  · intro hmem
    cases hs : linearSearch x l with
    | none => exact absurd hmem (linearSearch_none hs)
    | some i => rfl
